Composition & Indication

Fluoxetine 20mg — 30 Capsules (Generic for Prozac®) contains Fluoxetine Hydrochloride 20 mg as the active ingredient. This presentation ships as a sealed pack of 30 Capsules at the official 20mg strength. The standard indication is the management of depression, OCD and panic disorder, per Mexican pharmacopeia labeling.

Typical Use

Fluoxetine 20mg is typically taken under medical supervision. Dose and duration should follow your physician’s prescription. Do not self-medicate. Possible side effects include common reactions described in the patient leaflet; consult your healthcare provider if any adverse symptom appears or persists.

Prescription Required. CMC Pharmacy Cabo verifies prescriptions per Mexican regulations (NOM-073-SSA1). Please consult your healthcare provider before use.
